name: veloura-backend-microservices
description: Root helper scripts for running all Veloura microservices together in development

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix product-service && npm install --prefix cart-service && npm install --prefix order-service
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,product,cart,order -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix product-service" "npm run dev --prefix cart-service" "npm run dev --prefix order-service"
scripts.start: concurrently -n gateway,product,cart,order -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm start --prefix api-gateway" "npm start --prefix product-service" "npm start --prefix cart-service" "npm start --prefix order-service"
